topics.topic: Whether start-up must stop or continue when obsolete run-spool removal fails
questions: If `store.remove_run_spool` cannot remove an obsolete spool during recovery, does start-up stop, or does the kernel open its surface and retry the cleanup on a later start?
If capability:store.remove_run_spool fails during start-up recovery, does the kernel stop the start or continue and open the surface with that spool still present?

quotes: `capability:surface.serve_kernel` calls, in this order, every step required and stopping the start with its reason on the first failure:
Spools of ended runs that keep none are removed, except one that cannot be removed, which stays until a later start removes it; spools of `failed` unreleased runs stay.
judgement.why: The first passage requires start-up to stop on the cleanup failure, while the second permits the failed cleanup to remain until a later start.

topics.topic: Capability used to inspect credential headers during start-up without resolving secrets
questions: Through which `module:installation` capability does `module:bindings.check_installed_instances` enumerate services with credentials and read each credential header name without resolving the secret value?

topics.topic: Representation used when a read operation returns a file
questions: When a read operation returns a file, does the output cross back as a StoredValue or as a SpooledFile?

topics.topic: Whether automatic kernel work records identify the kernel as actor and where
questions: Must records produced automatically during admission, execution and start-up recovery explicitly identify the kernel as actor, and if so which record carries that identity?

topics.topic: Whether not_sent permits an attempted effect that sends no bytes
questions: Does the stated outcome mean an effect is always actually sent once, or at most one send is attempted and a not_sent attempt sends no bytes?

topics.topic: Who removes spools for runs finalized during start-up recovery
questions: When recovery derives a previously non-final run as succeeded, refused or cancelled, who removes its spool, given that the only spool-removal pass occurs before that derivation?
